headline: Eyevinn OSC provisions 184 open-source services for AI agents
summary: New MCP server offers portable, open backend stack
details: The Eyevinn Open Source Cloud (OSC) is an MCP server that provisions 184 managed open-source backend services through conversation. When an AI agent is done, it provides a stack that runs unmodified open-source containers.
The OSC allows users to take the stack, export it, and run it themselves. A vendor-locked platform cannot offer this level of control and portability.
The OSC MCP endpoint is a standard streamable-HTTP server, compatible with clients like Claude Code and Codex. Users can provision services like PostgreSQL databases and S3-compatible object stores.
caption:
Can your AI agent deploy a backend? Eyevinn OSC says yes

The Eyevinn Open Source Cloud (OSC) is an MCP server that provisions 184 managed open-source backend services through conversation. When an AI agent is done, it provides a stack that runs unmodified open-source containers.

The OSC allows users to take the stack, export it, and run it themselves. A vendor-locked platform cannot offer this level of control and portability.

The OSC MCP endpoint is a standard streamable-HTTP server, compatible with clients like Claude Code and Codex. Users can provision services like PostgreSQL databases and S3-compatible object stores.

Source: DEV, Hacker News

headline_marked: The Onion [[creates 'Infowars' parody]] with AI-generated content
headline: The Onion creates 'Infowars' parody with AI-generated content
summary: The Onion creates a parody of Infowars, a satirical take on the conspiracy theory website. The move is seen as a form of social commentary.
details: The Onion, a satirical news organization, has created a parody of Infowars, a website known for spreading conspiracy theories. The move is seen as a form of social commentary, highlighting the absurdity of Infowars' content.
The parody, also called 'Infowars', uses AI-generated content to mimic the style of the original website. The Onion's goal is to satirize Infowars' approach to news and information.
The creation of the parody comes as Infowars' owner, Alex Jones, faces criticism for spreading misinformation. The Onion's parody is seen as a way to poke fun at Infowars' style of reporting.
caption:
The Onion takes on Infowars with AI-generated parody

The Onion, a satirical news organization, has created a parody of Infowars, a website known for spreading conspiracy theories. The move is seen as a form of social commentary, highlighting the absurdity of Infowars' content.

The creation of the parody comes as Infowars' owner, Alex Jones, faces criticism for spreading misinformation. The Onion's parody is seen as a way to poke fun at Infowars' style of reporting.
